authorization_required: Separate explicit Abiodun authorization for Phase 6; this file authorizes nothing.

actor.rule: deterministic argmax mode, conditional mean, registered half-up q_e4

run.fallback_policy: Fixed external fallback mode_id=11, q_e4=9800, anchor action_id=71, AE32/UINT4, profile_id=split_ae32_uint4_q9800. An open ticket or a hold with fewer than k_min=2 transmitted tensors continues its exact action; a guard refusal never interrupts it. At a genuine decision opportunity a refused state does not call the actor, opens no ticket, transmits action 71 with reward_requested=false, logs every typed reason and the exact fallback identity, is excluded from learning/reward/policy-decision counts, leaves the last policy action/outcome untouched, still passes edge identity validation and map installation, and the next 10-Hz frame retries. No TTL.
run.excluded_outcomes: Undefined Q_perc (no eligible live GT) and evaluator faults are excluded EVALUATOR_FAULT outcomes; by the Run-4 contract they cannot become a previous outcome, so the next policy decision opens a new decision session at genesis (counted as session_rollovers, reported). Any failure after tensor assignment but before a successful send is an excluded INFRASTRUCTURE_FAULT and stops the run.

preflight: git HEAD recorded; all pre-existing dirty paths re-hashed and unchanged
readiness_v2 verify passes (sealed manifest equals working tree)
host cold: no containers, softmodems, tracer clients, oaitun, CARLA; /proc/loadavg recorded; no other user's CARLA/OAI
radio_binding.verify and EMITTER_PINS pass; compiled T_messages copies consistent

CUDA preload gate: torch.cuda available; perception, ranker, AE128/64/32 checkpoints hash-verified against the manifest before load; one warm-up forward per preloaded module; zero hot-path model loads
actor loaded via frozen_actor_v2.load_registered_actor (CPU, weights_only); boundary digest b61f27a9...bd3
direct edge-to-map endpoint resolved from `docker network inspect oai-cn5g-public-net` (expected 192.168.70.129:39320); publisher refuses UE tunnel/loopback/0.0.0.0/UE result ports
reward-feedback return endpoint on the UE resolved and recorded; it must be distinct from the map endpoint
launch_sequence: core up, then pinned launcher attach (run_splitfusion_oai_100mhz_4d5u_v1.sh)
multi relays 2023->2123 and 2021->2121; record attached; three v2 live readers attached; bridge warm (>=8 PDCP anchors)
telnet channel prime to FAVORABLE_STABLE and read-back
edge tail + map server preloaded and ready
CARLA route start; sensor preparation publishes camera SI and radar P40 per frame (live seam: splitfusion_scene_descriptor_live_v1)

per frame: snapshot -> commit -> action open -> (decision frames) build_live_state -> actor -> resolve_q_e4 -> identity seam -> SFD3 -> transport; held frames reuse the action with reward_requested=false; every frame to tail and map
stop after 300 transmitted frames and final ticket closure/timeout
teardown: stop live readers, then RAN (teardown_ran), then extract ue.raw
telnet restore clean noise; channelmod read-back equals the initial state
core down; final_cold_with_core == cold; no residual tunnel, tracer, sender, receiver or CARLA process
evidence_fields: per decision: decision_seq, snapshot_seq, snapshot latency, state_commit/action_open RAW ns, telemetry sample identities/sources/availability/ages, guard verdict and typed fallback reasons, features sha, actor heads sha, mode_id, q_e4, execution_bundle_sha256, nullable anchor action_id, measurement_status
per frame: frame_id, tensor_seq, ticket_seq, reward_requested, SFD3 wire bytes, inner payload sha, send/receive times, map install time and map ACK time (separate), edge identity verdict
per ticket: feedback class ledger (ACCEPTED/DUPLICATE_IGNORED/LATE_ORPHAN/UNKNOWN_ORPHAN), resolution terminal, latency_ms, reward, excluded-fault flags
run: radio binding and emitter pins before/after, raw-replay comparison of every selected DCI/RLC sample, restore read-back, cold state

gates.P1_IDENTITY: every executed frame's SFD3 identity equals the actor decision and the contract resolution; zero edge refusals other than injected faults
gates.P2_TELEMETRY: Phase-2C gates G1, G3, G4, G6-G10 re-applied on the live run; fresh coverage reported (not gated) because CARLA payloads change grant timing
gates.P3_HOLD_TICKET: every decision has >=2 transmitted tensors; exactly one reward-requested tensor per decision; zero cross-frame reward attachment; zero conflicting feedback
gates.P4_ACCOUNTING: decisions == resolutions + (at most one open at stop); feedback ledger classes sum to received feedback; every delivered frame installed on the map
gates.P6_RESTORE_COLD: restore read-back equals initial; host application-cold

P0_POLICY_COVERAGE.rule: after the first 10 decision opportunities, at least 95% must be admitted policy decisions with valid fresh MCS/backlog (fallback fraction <= 5%)

gates.P7_FEEDBACK_OVER_DOWNLINK: edge->UE R4FB feedback observed on oaitun_ue1 for every received feedback message; edge container route to 10.0.0.2 via the UPF (192.168.70.134); feedback endpoint distinct from the direct-map endpoint
gates.P8_NO_INFRASTRUCTURE_FAULT: no post-assignment transport failure and no conflicting reward feedback
